title: National Civil Service Exam Preparation Platform
description: A full-stack learning platform for India's national civil service exam (UPSC). I built the data pipeline that aggregates real-time news, government updates, and policy content from multiple sources, transforms them via LLM API calls into exam-relevant insights, and surfaces them through a personalized React frontend.
highlight: The core engineering challenge is middleware — designing a pipeline that ingests unstructured content, applies prompt-based transformation via Groq/Llama, maps outputs to an issue-based knowledge model, and serves structured learning data to the UI.

title: Collaborative Music Rehearsal Platform
description: A collaborative rehearsal platform where the data model is the feature — role-based state (singer, musician, manager) determines what each user sees and can do in real time. I designed the data structure for part assignments and reassignment workflows, then built the React interface that responds to those state changes.
highlight: The core challenge was designing a role-aware data layer that could push the right subset of rehearsal data to each user type — so the UI stayed simple while the underlying logic handled the complexity.

title: CareerCanvas – A Career Growth Platform
description: A personalized career guidance platform for users aged 15–35. I designed the data model and API structure for career routes, experience logging, and goal tracking — then built the React frontend on top of those endpoints, with role-based routing and adaptive content based on user profile data.
highlight: The architecture decision that mattered most was separating content data from user progress state — designing clean API contracts between the data layer and UI modules so each could evolve independently.

title: Full-Stack Luggage Booking Web App
description: A production-ready luggage delivery platform. I designed the Supabase data schema for bookings, pricing rules, and order sessions, integrated the Stripe payment API with server-side confirmation logic, and used Google Maps API for real-time address resolution — then built the React booking UI on top of all three.
highlight: The middleware layer does the heavy work: dynamic pricing is calculated from real address data, Stripe webhooks update order state in Supabase, and the UI reflects that state in real time via Supabase subscriptions.

title: UX Research: Tech Support for Older Adults
description: Studied how older adults prefer and interact with video-based tech support.
highlight: Merged design empathy with real user needs — identifying pain points and usability gaps.

title: Distributed Object Store with Integrity
description: Simulated a fault-tolerant distributed storage system using Docker and erasure coding.
highlight: Built the integrity-checking system and ran client simulations to test node failure recovery.

title: Sweet Home Finder
description: A full-stack pet adoption platform. I designed the PostgreSQL schema and Sequelize ORM models, built the Express REST API layer (authentication, CRUD, admin routes), and implemented Socket.IO for real-time chat between adopters and shelters — then connected the entire data layer to a React frontend.
highlight: Designed the full API surface — auth endpoints, role-based access middleware, and real-time messaging — before writing a single UI component. The data model drove every frontend decision.

title: HabiTrack – Habit Tracker with Motivation
description: A habit tracker built on Firebase — I structured the Firestore data model for habits, streaks, and milestones, set up real-time listeners so the UI responds instantly to data changes, and implemented Firebase Auth with session persistence. The frontend animations and dashboards are driven entirely by live data state.
highlight: Designed the Firestore document structure to make streak calculations efficient at query time — so the UI never has to compute what the data layer already knows.

title: MediCARE App for Parkinson’s Detection
description: Award-winning project combining voice and handwriting data to detect Parkinson’s with 91.3%+ accuracy.
highlight: Led the development, presented at an international conference, and won “Best Project Presentation.”
